items.name: Carolina Beach Scallop Shell Printed Crewneck Sweatshirt
items.alt: White crewneck sweatshirt with a small navy and coral scallop shell drawing printed on the left chest, shown as an illustrative image
items.meta: A hand-inked navy and coral scallop shell printed small on the left chest of a white garment-dyed crewneck. A Carolina Beach layer for cool evenings on the coast.
facts: 9.5 oz garment-dyed, 80% ring-spun cotton and 20% polyester
Scallop shell drawing about 3.25 in wide on the left chest, printed not embroidered
Machine wash cold, tumble dry low. Garment dye means the shade varies slightly from piece to piece
